messages:
Maya R.: Hey folks, packing for the SF conf — any quick tips to avoid lost luggage? I need to bring a demo laptop, 2 charger bricks, and some swag. red-eye + 1 layover.
Kevin L.: If you can fit it, carry-on only. checked bags = lost-bag roulette.
Olivia T.: If swag is bulk, I ship it to the hotel a few days early and mark it "Hold for Guest: Maya R." — saved me twice.
Samir: Always put laptop + chargers in your personal item. keep meds + one change of shirt there too.
Maya R.: Good call — anything you actually *pack in carry-on vs checked*?
Kevin L.: Carry-on: laptop, chargers, dongles, passport, meds, one outfit. Checked: bulk swag, extra shoes.
Olivia T.: Packing cubes are life. also put small valuables in a zip-top bag with a note listing contents. label inside luggage with phone/email.
Samir: Pro tip: take photos of the bag and contents before checking. if it gets lost, airline claims go faster with pics + serial numbers.
Maya R.: What about SIM / wifi? should I bother with an eSIM or just use hotel wifi?
Kevin L.: Buy an eSIM (Airalo) before you land. faster than kiosk lines. also carry a tiny universal adapter.
Olivia T.: Also, clear plastic toiletry quart bag in an easy-to-grab spot for security — speeds up layovers.
Jo (travelbot): Reminder: TSA liquids rule — containers <= 100ml / 3.4oz in a single quart-sized bag. :airplane:
Maya R.: Ha, thanks Jo. Any small things to make the bag identifiable?
Samir: Bright ribbon or a neon luggage strap. I also slap a business card inside a pocket with my mobile + email.
Olivia T.: If you're checking branded swag, consider shipping insurance for the box only if it's expensive. otherwise cheaper to replace a few items.
Maya R.: Last q: should I label each swag item with a small sticker that has 'redwood-inference' + batch no? shipping/returns worry.
Kevin L.: Label inside and outside. also a tiny packing manifest in the box (simple list). makes customs/claims less annoying.
Maya R.: Awesome, all super helpful. packing cubes + eSIM + photos + ribbon. thanks y'all :heart:
Olivia T.: Safe travels! :plane_departure:
